entities.name: Miguel Ángel Osorio Chong
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel Ángel Osorio Chong is a Mexican politician affiliated with the Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI). He served as the Secretary of the Interior in the cabinet of Enrique Peña Nieto from 2012 to 2018 and was also Governor of Hidalgo from 2005 to 2011.
